title: The Spire of the Ninefold Court Anew
author: Zephyrine Almeida
blurb: Felix Dunmore, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
